text:
elaine: quick FYI — customer reported a streaming session that stalled for ~30s when they hit a soft tenant quota threshold. console showed connection as OPEN and client was still receiving keepalive pings, but no data events for that time. attaching logs below.

elaine: ```
[2026-03-20T15:12:01Z] tenant=acme quota_state=HYSTERESIS route=stable-1 action=hold
[2026-03-20T15:12:01Z] sse: paused-sending payloads until quota_cooldown
[2026-03-20T15:12:31Z] tenant=acme quota_state=THROTTLED route=fallback-spot action=resume
``` 

sai: hmm, looks like we switch to a hold policy (no sends) during hysteresis instead of gracefully switching to a lower-cost model or short-circuiting to cached prefix. that explains why client saw pings but no events.

rohan: is that behaviour by design? i thought the routing policy should fallback to a compatible model variant, not pause the stream entirely.

marta: it used to fallback, yes. i remember a rollout where we toggled on a global 'suppress-during-quota' flag to avoid burst charges. that flag might still be enabled for some regions.

elaine: confirmed — rollout flag SUPPRESS_STREAM_DURING_QUOTA = true for eu-west cluster. console rollout UI shows it as "enabled (partial)" but it's unclear which tenants are affected.

console-eng: good point. console currently only shows feature flag status by cluster, not by tenant. we should expose per-tenant effective policy for debugging.

sai: short-term fix: change hold -> route to 'cached-prefix' or 'quantized-variant' so clients keep getting events with degraded fidelity. long-term: add a routing decision telemetry label: route_decision={hold,fallback,cached,quantized} and quota_state={ok,hysteresis,throttled}.

rohan: also need to ensure billing isn't double-counted when we resume on a different route. previously we saw duplicate charge markers when route flips mid-session.

elaine: yes saw that in the traces — billing id was the same but token-count attribution got split and console showed >100% usage spike. suspect meter increments are tied to route id and we don't dedupe resume events.

marta: for console UX: add a mini timeline in the streaming trace view: show per-session events: [heartbeat, pause, route_change, resume] with timestamps + policy. will help customer support quickly identify hysteresis stalls.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: "streaming-routing-fallbacks" -> canary on eu-west-1 (2 nodes) at 3745556700. CI green.

sai: I'll push a small PR to change SUPPRESS_STREAM_DURING_QUOTA to fallthrough-to-cached for canary, and add the new telemetry labels. keeps change surface small.

rohan: can we add a cheap metric guard to avoid billing dupes? maybe only count tokens on the initial route id and mark subsequent resume events as continuation. i can sketch that.

marta: timeline item: add console timeline + flag visibility by tenant. low-priority for next sprint but we should document the workaround now.

elaine: action items:
- sai: canary change for fallback behavior + telemetry labels (ship today) 
- rohan: billing dedupe guard (patch, target this week)
- console-eng: timeline UX + per-tenant flag visibility (design ticket)

elaine: linking support thread and customer logs: https://redwood.internal/s/threads/ACME-1234

console-eng: noted. i'll add a small dashboard panel: "streaming: sessions with quota_state=HYSTERESIS" and expose route_decision breakdown. that should make it obvious if holds are happening.

marta: ping me if you want a quick hand with the UX copy — we should call the flag something less scary than SUPPRESS_STREAM.

elaine: thanks all. canary will start at 3745556700, i'll monitor traces and customer channel.

sai: monitoring checklist: ensure no increase in 5xx, check token-meter spikes, confirm route_decision shows "cached" during hysteresis. will post update in this thread.

deploy-bot: canary deploy succeeded on node eu-west-1a at 3745556725 :white_check_mark:

sai: canary looks good so far, we see continuous events during hysteresis window and no duplicate billing markers in the sample trace.

rohan: ack — i'll still push the billing guard. better safe.

elaine: wrapping up: we'll flip the flag cluster-wide after rohan's billing guard lands and console timeline is at least provisioned in dashboard. thanks team :pray:
